case.title: Password reset link expired
case.subject: Can't log in - reset link not working
case.text:
Hi, I clicked 'forgot password' yesterday evening but only opened the email this morning and now the link says it's expired. How do I get back in? I have appointments to check today.

Thanks, Fatima
case.why: Everyday account-access question fully answered by the KB (link expires after 60 minutes, request a new one).

output.reply:
Hi Fatima,

Sorry about the trouble, and I understand you need to check today's appointments. The reset link expires after 60 minutes and can only be used once, so you'll need to request a new one:

1. On the sign-in page, click Forgot password?
2. Enter the email address you use for Slotwise.
3. Open the new email and click the link within 60 minutes.

If the email doesn't arrive within 5 minutes, check your spam folder. Also, after 5 failed login attempts the account is locked for 15 minutes, so if that happens just wait and try again.

If you're a staff member, your account owner can also send you a reset from Staff → your name → Access → Send password reset.

Slotwise Support
